args.body: Check BOAMP-DATE-FIRST-LINK-QA-PILOT status and take it under valid ownership if unfinished. Reuse existing extraction or director-nested-scope-readback.json if committed. Compare notice objects, deadlines and nested fields before relying on keyword counts. Retrieve an original notice only for a concrete live lead. If it supports separately quotable link QA, run passing and failing offline controls against the buyer's acceptance criterion and preserve the actual output. Prepare an operator quote only if supplier eligibility, submission authority and payment terms are supported. Otherwise record the bounded coverage and the precise evidence that would reopen the route. Read back and close with a lesson. No external submission.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback has no new classified signal and five sources remain unclassified, so demand is unknown. Its 12 returned records are all dated 23 November, and the initial extraction found no scope pointers. That result supports checking the saved record fields before retrieving another page.
